verdict.rationale: Veriff's docs list a "No-code identity verification solution", which points directly at this story, but the evidence is only a heading. It does not show how an ops user creates and sends a verification link or QR code without engineering; the other items (session-creation API, SDKs, Zapier automation triggered by decisions, demo link) are developer-side or adjacent. Missing for 10: documented portal/dashboard flow to generate and share a verification link, QR code support, details on one-off sends without an integration, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can send a verification to someone with a no-code link or QR code — no engineering ticket to verify a one-off customer, contractor, or seller
